title: Review of the reacting-thermals SIMDH claim: selection replicates on 3 fresh seeds with the neutral twin (b share 0.87-0.90 vs 0.45-0.72; births b:a 89-100 vs 8-13), I, D, S replicate; M by construction (buoyant drift in imposed gravity, per my audit)
summary: Read world.py's label and mutation code: the labels are made only where a cap burns (kl r a (1-a-b)), carried by the cap's own fluid, and swapped in a 6-px disk at a burning pixel drawn without reading the label; the heat yield Q(1+eps(a-b)) is the written fitness effect. labkit re-runs of the claimed world on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (eps -0.1): 53 and 58 persistent splits, generation 6 and 7, merge/split 0.18/0.16. heredity2.py (copied unchanged) on seeds 21-23 in both arms: mean b share t=400-1200 is 0.90/0.87/0.89 favoured against 0.49/0.72/0.45 in the eps 0 twin with the same mutation draws; births b:a 89:11, 100:8, 93:13 favoured vs 36:42, 70:34, 39:45 neutral; daughters keep the parent's kind at 95/100, 106/108, 103/106 splits; kind flips of living caps fall at a logged mutation 27/29, 27/30, 32/35 times. Named track on my seed: seed 21 track 654, a kind-b cap born by a split at t=863 that rises 9.2 sqrt(area) (6.5 long axes) and divides at t=935 into two kind-b daughters, one of which divides again at t=1006.

observations.H: share_b.png, heredity_summary.txt: b share 0.90/0.87/0.89 favoured vs 0.49/0.72/0.45 in the identical-draw neutral twin on seeds 21-23; births b:a 89:11, 100:8, 93:13 vs 36:42, 70:34, 39:45; daughters keep the kind at 304/314 splits; flips of living caps at a mutation 86 of 94

seeds_run.result: pass (neutral twin drifted to 0.72, still below 0.87)

controls_run.H: pack_neutral/ (eps 0, seeds 21 22, labkit) and m_s21-23_e0.json (heredity2.py, eps 0, same mutation draw sequence) against the eps -0.1 arm

verdicts.limitation: M is buoyant rise in an imposed uniform gravity; my audit (20261027T0534-c53-audit-thermals, passive_control.png) shows a non-burning, heat-conserving thermal rises at the caps' speed, so I mark it by construction here too (divmove counts if scored: 11 of 15 and 18 of 28 dividing caps >= 3 sqrt(area); 3 of 15 and 6 of 28 in long axes). The fitness effect is written into the heat yield, and mutation is frequent and symmetric, so the neutral twin drifts widely (0.45-0.72 on 3 seeds; one seed passes 0.85 for a while near t=750): the margin is consistent but rests on 3+6 seeds of ~25 caps. Caps are mixtures (median purity 0.82-0.90); deaths by kind include tracker breaks. The label channels show a fine ripple texture in the wakes after t~400 (pack_sel sheets), probably the clipped, weakly damped labels; it does not reach the caps' kind. 128^2, one parameter point, no dt/2 or grid test of the labelled world.
